$comment: Measured on the PAP-31 build container (Node 22.22.2, Linux 6.18, no Docker daemon, no browser, no Android emulator). Only the local-store half of the Electric+PGlite client could be executed here; see results/README.md. null means NOT MEASURED, never zero.

electric-pglite.scope: local store only (PGlite 0.5.8 in Node; no Electric server, no network, no browser)

zero.reason: zero-cache needs a running Postgres with logical replication; no Docker daemon in this container.

powersync.reason: powersync-service needs Docker and a running Postgres; wa-sqlite needs a browser/OPFS.

replicache.reason: not benchmarked: eliminated on the maturity hard criterion (archived 2026-06-10).

baseline-tanstack-outbox.reason: needs the PaperOS API (PAP-35), which does not exist yet.
